Faq.title: Everything you need to know
Faq.subtitle: Common questions about TrackBay.
Faq.q1: Does TrackBay access my bank account?
Faq.a1: No, never. You enter your subscriptions manually. No bank connection, no shared financial data.
Faq.a3: Yes, available on the App Store and Google Play.
Faq.a4: Your data is encrypted and stored securely. We never sell it.
Faq.a5: You receive a push notification 2 days before each scheduled payment date.
Faq.q6: What types of subscriptions can I track?
Faq.a6: Anything recurring — Netflix, Spotify, rent, insurance, utilities, gym memberships. If it repeats, TrackBay tracks it.
Faq.a7: Yes, TrackBay supports weekly, monthly, and annual billing cycles.
Faq.q8: Does TrackBay work without an internet connection?
Faq.a8: Your subscription list is cached locally, so you can view it offline.
Faq.q9: How many subscriptions can I add?
Faq.a9: There is no limit. Add as many subscriptions as you need.
Faq.q10: What's the difference between TrackBay and checking my bank statement?
Faq.a10: TrackBay shows upcoming payments before they happen, not after. You get notified days in advance so you can cancel or budget accordingly.

Privacy.s1Content: The data controller responsible for your personal data is Thomas Geslin, based in France (contact: thomas.geslin31@gmail.com). Definitions include Account, Affiliate, Application, Company, Country, Device, Personal Data, Service, Service Provider, Usage Data, You.
Privacy.s2Title: Collecting and Using Your Personal Data
Privacy.s2Content: Types of Data Collected include Personal Data (email, first and last name, usage data) and Usage Data (device identifiers, IP, browser, app usage).
Privacy.s3Content: We use data to provide and maintain the service, manage accounts, contact users, provide updates, manage requests, evaluate and improve service, and for legal/business purposes. Push Notifications: We use push notifications to remind you of upcoming expenses or account-related events. You can disable push notifications at any time in your device's operating system settings.
Privacy.s4Content: We retain data while you maintain an active account. If you delete your account, we delete or anonymize your data within 30 days, unless required otherwise by law.
Privacy.s5Content: Your data may be transferred internationally with safeguards to ensure adequate protection.
Privacy.s6Content: You may delete data via the app or by contacting us. We delete or anonymize data within 30 days unless required otherwise.
Privacy.s7Content: We may disclose personal data for business transactions, law enforcement, or legal obligations.
Privacy.s8Content: We use commercially acceptable means to protect your data but cannot guarantee absolute security.
Privacy.s9Content: Our service is not directed to children under 13. We do not knowingly collect data from children. Parents may contact us to remove data.
Privacy.s10Title: Your Rights Under GDPR and CCPA
Privacy.s10Content: EEA: Right to access, update, delete, restrict, object, data portability, complaint. You may also lodge a complaint with your national supervisory authority — in France, the CNIL (cnil.fr). California: Right to know, request deletion, opt out of sale. We do not sell personal data.
Privacy.s11Content: Our Service may contain links to external websites. We are not responsible for third-party practices.
Privacy.s12Content: We may update this Privacy Policy and will notify users via email and/or in-app notice.
Privacy.s13Content: If you have questions: Visit https://trackbayapp.com/contact or email thomas.geslin31@gmail.com
Privacy.s14Content: We work with trusted third-party service providers who may receive your personal data to help us operate and improve TrackBay. Supabase (supabase.com/privacy) acts as our backend and stores all personal data including your email address, name, and subscription information. PostHog (posthog.com/privacy) receives your email address as a user identifier, along with in-app usage events, to help us understand how TrackBay is used and improve the product. RevenueCat (revenuecat.com/privacy) receives your email address, app user ID, and subscription or purchase data to manage in-app subscriptions and entitlements. Sentry (sentry.io/privacy) receives device information, operating system version, crash logs, and stack traces — and may include your email address when linked to an error report — to help us detect and fix issues. In-app purchases are processed by Apple (App Store) or Google (Google Play), each subject to their own privacy policies.
Privacy.s15Content: If you are located in the European Economic Area, we process your personal data under the following legal bases as required by GDPR Article 6. Account creation and service delivery: performance of a contract (Art. 6(1)(b)). Product analytics via PostHog and error monitoring via Sentry: legitimate interests in improving and maintaining a stable service (Art. 6(1)(f)). Push notification reminders: your consent, which you may withdraw at any time via your device settings (Art. 6(1)(a)). Subscription management via RevenueCat: performance of a contract (Art. 6(1)(b)). Compliance with legal obligations: legal obligation (Art. 6(1)(c)).
